cohort: GLASS RNA silver-set, IDH-mutant, RT-annotated, TP+R1 paired

deconvolution_methods.quantiseq: TIL10 curated NNLS + canonical Plasma/Microglia extension, fractions in [0,1] -> LMM primary
deconvolution_methods.epic: EPIC curated NNLS, fractions in [0,1] -> LMM robustness
deconvolution_methods.mcpcounter: abundance scores (NOT fractions) -> robustness only, never LMM

purity.source: GLASS clinical tables carry no ESTIMATE/ABSOLUTE purity; the signature-mass proxy was near-degenerate (0.996-1.000), so a constant 0.62 (Johnson 2026 bulk median) is used. Being constant, the term is absorbed by the intercept and the LMM drops it.

limitations: GLASS has no matched snRNA-seq -> stock published signatures only, not the discovery custom CIBERSORTx signature.

treatment_radiotherapy is surgery-level and its ordering semantics differ across GLASS source cohorts; the patient-level 'ever RT' rule is order-invariant and matches the discovery Any_RT/No_RT operational rule.
GLASS cohort is grade-heterogeneous (II-IV) whereas discovery was grade II only; who_grade_initial is carried as a model covariate.
Discovery primary result was null; GLASS is a direction-consistency check only.
